KEY SYSTEM
A valid Vampauth key is required. Use the Get key button in the script or the public key link on this page to obtain a key. Both FFA and HWID-bound licenses are supported when validated by Vampauth.

PRIVACY DISCLOSURE
License validation sends your license key, Roblox client identifier used as HWID, and executor name to Vampauth. Vampauth processes licensing information and records validation usage.

Provider privacy policy: https://vampauth.com/privacy
